mapper.insert: insert into production_order (order_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{productQuantity}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from production_order where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
